coarse_certificate.proof: Every path action in each invariant terminal family preserves the full product binary heavy-atom graph. Thus broken/formed heavy bonds cannot vary within that family. No target restricted pattern matches any invariant terminal modulo the same reactant symmetry; noninvariant terminals prevent exclusion.
